requirements: R1: Resolve Moodle Integration 401 Unauthorized errors and failing CI tests, ensuring error patterns like 400, 401, and 403 are correctly handled and verified.
R2: Implement the full Moodle integration specification, including robust role synchronization and autonomous fallback mechanisms.

slices.title: Resolve Moodle Integration Authentication and Role Sync Failures
slices.jtbd: When implementing the Moodle integration for this epic, I want to resolve the 401 Unauthorized errors, handle 400/401/403 patterns, and implement full role sync and autonomous fallback, so that the underlying CI tests pass and the orchestrator can cleanly verify the codebase.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an authenticated Moodle request, When it is processed, Then it correctly synchronizes roles and supports autonomous fallback without 401 errors.
Given an invalid or unauthorized request, When it is processed, Then the system returns explicit 400, 401, or 403 errors.
Given the complete implementation, When tests are run, Then the integration is fully verified with passing CI tests.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Defect count in Moodle integration CI tests
